title: 第11章 问询前路第12章 告假归家
slug: 开局一枚玉佩凡女低调修仙
lines: 领取月例后的第二天，苏月再次去了访市。
这次她没有漫无目的地闲逛，而是直接走向售卖杂物和低阶药材的区域。
她的目标明确，那就是找到一个合适的敲门砖。
在坊市里，一百灵珠的购买力依然令人沮丧，大部分摊位看都不看她手中的灵珠。
但总有些角落，售卖着一些对杂役弟子而言还算实用的东西。
最终，苏月在一个老妇人的摊位前停下，那里摆着一些自制的药膏和低阶符箓。
她花去了十五枚灵珠，买了一小瓶用于止血的药膏。
这种药膏是杂役弟子们最欢迎的日常用品之一。
买完药膏，苏月便离开了访市，她要去寻找一个人帮她解决困惑。
在刚来杂役峰时，她曾无意间听过一些老杂役谈论修炼的困境，其中一位正是提到杂役灵根到了练气五层就难以寸进的姜晴。
她能说出这些，想必对宗门内的事情有所了解，或许能解答自己的疑惑。
寻找姜晴并不难，在杂役峰，老杂役弟子的活动范围相对固定。
苏月打听了一番，最终在灵稻田边缘的一座破旧木屋前找到了她。
姜晴看起来约莫三四十岁，身材瘦小，眼神中带着长年劳作的疲惫和一丝看透世事的平静。
苏月走上前，恭敬地行了一礼：“姜晴师姐，打扰您了。”
姜晴抬眼看了看她，没有说话，眼中带着一丝疑惑。
苏月有些紧张，但还是鼓起勇气，将手中的药膏递上前：“姜晴师姐，我是新来的杂役苏月。”
“在田里干活时，听您说起过杂灵根修炼的难处，觉得您知道很多。
这瓶药膏是我的一点心意，想向您请教几个问题，希望没有打扰到您。”
姜晴看了看那瓶药膏，又看了看苏月真诚但略带忐忑的眼神。
她在杂役峰待得够久，见过太多想一步登天的新人。
但苏月眼中的那份小心翼翼，让她没有立刻拒绝。
她接过药膏，掂了掂分量，点了点头：“你这丫头倒是有心。
说吧，想问什么。”
苏月心中一喜，知道自己找对人了。
苏月定了定心神，先问出了最挂念的问题：“师姐，想请教一下我可否有机会下山回家探亲？”
姜晴缓缓道：“宗门并非无情之地，杂役弟子，确实可以请假下山探亲。”
苏月眼中闪过一丝光亮。
“规矩上，通常允许一年请假一次。”
姜晴接着说，语气带上了一点难以言喻的意味。
“不过许多杂役弟子，在宗门待上两三年后，往往就不会再提出下山了。”
“这是为何？”
content_en:
The day after receiving the monthly prescription, Su Yue visited the market again.
This time she did not wander aimlessly, but went directly to the area where sundries and low-level medicinal materials were sold.
Her goal is clear, that is, to find a suitable stepping stone.
In the market, the purchasing power of a hundred spirit beads was still dismal, and most stalls did not even look at the spirit beads in her hand.
But there are always some corners selling some things that are useful to the handyman disciples.
Finally, Su Yue stopped in front of an old woman's stall, where some homemade ointments and low-level talismans were displayed.
She spent fifteen spirit beads and bought a small bottle of ointment to stop bleeding.
This ointment is one of the most popular daily necessities among handyman disciples.
After buying the ointment, Su Yue left to visit the market. She was going to find someone to help her solve her confusion.
When she first came to the handyman peak, she had overheard some old handymen talking about the difficulties of cultivation. One of them was Jiang Qing, who mentioned that the handyman's spiritual roots were difficult to advance at the fifth level of Qi training.
For her to be able to tell these things, she must have some knowledge of the affairs within the sect, and may be able to answer her own doubts.
It is not difficult to find Jiang Qing. On the Zaiyong Peak, the range of activities of the old Zaiyuan disciples is relatively fixed.
Su Yue made some inquiries and finally found her in front of a dilapidated wooden house on the edge of the Ling rice field.
Jiang Qing looked to be about thirty or forty years old, with a thin build, and her eyes showed the exhaustion of long years of work and a hint of calmness that had seen through the world.
Su Yue stepped forward and bowed respectfully: "Senior Sister Jiang Qing, I'm sorry to bother you."
Jiang Qing raised her eyes and looked at her without saying anything, with a trace of doubt in her eyes.
Su Yue was a little nervous, but she still mustered up the courage and handed the ointment in her hand forward: "Sister Jiang Qing, I am the new handyman Su Yue."
“When I was working in the fields, I heard you talk about the difficulties of cultivating miscellaneous spiritual roots, and I felt that you knew a lot.
This bottle of ointment is a piece of my heart. I want to ask you a few questions. I hope it won't disturb you. "
Jiang Qing looked at the bottle of ointment, and then at Su Yue's sincere but slightly worried eyes.
She has stayed in Zaoyu Peak long enough and has seen too many newcomers who want to reach the sky in one step.
But the caution in Su Yue's eyes prevented her from refusing immediately.
She took the ointment, weighed it, and nodded: "You have good intentions, girl.
Tell me what you want to ask. "
Su Yue felt happy, knowing that she had found the right person.
Su Yue calmed down and asked the question that concerned her most: "Senior sister, would you like to ask if I have the opportunity to go down the mountain to visit my relatives?"
Jiang Qing said slowly: "The sect is not a heartless place, and the handyman disciples can indeed ask for leave to go down the mountain to visit relatives."
A glimmer of light flashed in Su Yue's eyes.
"Rules generally allow you to take leave once a year."
Jiang Qing continued, her tone carrying an indescribable meaning.
"However, many handyman disciples, after staying in the sect for two or three years, often no longer ask to leave the mountain."
"Why?"
title_en: Chapter 11 Asking about the way forward Chapter 12 Taking leave and returning home
